instruction: Please help me install the ESLint extension in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the ESLint extension (dbaeumer.vscode-eslint) in VS Code. Evaluator verifies installation by checking if 'code --list-extensions' output contains the extension ID. Uses existing is_extension_installed metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies that the ESLint extension (dbaeumer.vscode-eslint) is installed
Uses the standard 'code --list-extensions' command which is the correct approach for checking VS Code extensions
Metric 'is_extension_installed' with type 'contain' appropriately checks if the extension ID appears in the output
Expected value 'dbaeumer.vscode-eslint' is the correct extension ID for ESLint
Complete coverage: instruction requires installation, evaluator verifies installation
Data flow is semantically correct: command output -> metric checks for substring -> returns 1.0 if found
Verification will work correctly even if shell piping doesn't execute as intended (code --list-extensions alone returns all extensions, metric will still find the target extension ID)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor note: The command uses pipe operator in list format without 'shell: true' parameter. Consider either: (1) adding 'shell: true' to enable proper piping, or (2) removing the grep pipe since the metric will search the full output anyway. Current implementation works correctly despite this because is_extension_installed searches the entire output string.
